Living Ink Quirk.name: Living Ink Quirk
Living Ink Quirk.description:
🖋️ Black ink flows from your fingertips, and simple drawings lift off the surface as ink constructs that move at your word.

🌱 Sketch a rope that hauls a person up or a hound that knocks a target down. A quick sketch is flimsy; a careful one holds an adult or stops a punch.
📈 Training adds drawn nets, scout birds that come back as a sketch of what they saw, ladders, shields, a whole pack at once and a mural that keeps working without you.
⚠️ Constructs fade after a few minutes and dissolve in water, so rain, a hose or a sprinkler ends them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as your body makes ink slowly and a long fight leaves your fingertips dry.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Visual Arts +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Drawn Lifeline, Sketched Hound
Living Ink Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user's fingertips draw black ink on any dry surface; simple drawings lift off as solid constructs up to large-dog or door size, obeying spoken orders in sight. New adult user: up to three; a quick sketch (seconds) breaks under a solid blow; a careful one (a full turn) holds an adult's weight, pulls a person, stops a punch, bites hard. More, bigger or self-acting constructs need techniques. Limits: constructs fade in about five minutes and dissolve at once in any water, even a crossed puddle; simple orders only, no speech, no copied look or power. Needs a free hand and a surface; ink refills slowly, so long fights run dry. Quirk Strain: light: rope, hound; moderate: net, scout bird, ladder; heavy: shield, pack; severe: signature beast, working mural. Type: Emitter. Law: unpermitted drawing on public walls is vandalism even if the ink fades; a construct's bite is the user's own assault. Look: gray-stained fingertips; glossy black drawings peel up.
